summary: A monthly first-Tuesday business networking lunch at Red Lobster on Tunnel Road, run by Incredible Towns of WNC as part of its multi-chapter Incredible Business Networking (IBN) program. It is explicitly free, drop-in, and has no membership, dues, or attendance requirements, so attendees are a rotating set of local professionals rather than a fixed group with returning members.

evidence.note: Listing explicitly says 'Drop in without membership, attendance requirements, or fees' and tags include 'Open To All' and 'Casual Networking'.
Second listing repeats the same 'no fees or attendance requirements, welcoming newcomers and regulars' framing.

Incredible Towns describes IBN as free and open to all, 'no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions,' and lists this Asheville lunch as first Tuesdays noon-1pm at Red Lobster, 139 Tunnel Road.
Asheville also hosts a separate IBN Coffee Connection chapter, confirming these are recurring drop-in event slots run by the same parent organization rather than a single persistent membership group.
